reuse.why: The flag is threaded through the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked guard, but the 'unlink account' field reset is pasted in again instead of being shared with unlinkAccount.

duplication.why: The db.updateAccount block that clears account_id/bank/balances/sync source/status is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount.

placement.why: Detaching the previous holder happens inside a function named and used as an assertion, so a guard now writes data, and it does so before the new link is attempted.

scope.why: The change is limited to the flag, the guard, its six call sites and a release note.

maintainability.why: Workable, but the unlink semantics now live in two copies that can drift (the request explicitly says 'as the unlink action leaves an account'), and the mutating assert is misleading.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/accounts/app.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked re-implements unlinkAccount's local reset (db.updateAccount with null link fields) instead of extracting and calling a shared helper.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied unlink update is verbatim, not disguised.
